goal: A Ralph-ready ticket must be independently understandable, implementable, verifiable, and reviewable by a fresh agent.
readyCriteria: One coherent primary responsibility or architectural seam
Required product and architecture decisions are already resolved
The ticket can be implemented without redesigning unrelated domains
The ticket has a focused validation strategy for its primary responsibility
A fresh agent can reconstruct necessary context from current authoritative repository and GitHub artifacts
Completion produces a meaningful independently reviewable increment
alreadySatisfiedSignals: All current acceptance criteria are demonstrably satisfied by already-integrated work
No independently meaningful implementation delta remains
Implementing the ticket would duplicate or conflict with existing integrated behavior
reshapeSignals: Combines multiple independently meaningful architectural responsibilities
Requires several unrelated schema, service, API, UI, or migration changes
Contains multiple independent migrations or backfills with separate invariants
Mixes foundation work with unrelated application behavior
Contains acceptance criteria that represent independently implementable and reviewable behaviors
Likely requires repeated long-context resumptions because several distinct responsibilities must be completed
An adversarial reviewer would need to evaluate several mostly independent implementation concerns
supervisedSignals: A required product or architecture decision is unresolved
The current issue conflicts with an accepted specification or ADR
Autonomous implementation would require choosing among materially different valid behaviors
Meaningful decomposition would create unsafe or misleading intermediate states
cohesionRules: Multiple fixtures, edge cases, or tests proving the same invariant remain one responsibility
Retry and recovery proof for the same migration or state transition remain part of that responsibility
Existing tests that must remain green are regression validation, not a separate implementation slice
Validation occurring at multiple levels does not by itself require decomposition
badSplitSignals: Split is based only on files
Split creates changes with no independently meaningful behavior or invariant
A child ticket cannot be safely integrated before its siblings
A child ticket has no independent validation strategy
